name: cwp-error-log
description: CWP webserver error log - monitors panel and web server errors

name: apache-error-log
description: Apache error log - monitors web server errors and PHP failures

name: mail-log
command: tail -F /var/log/maillog 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'error\|reject\|bounce' || echo 'Mail log not available'
description: Mail log - monitors email errors, rejections, and bounces

name: mysql-error-log
description: MySQL/MariaDB error log - monitors database crashes and errors

name: security-log
command: tail -F /var/log/secure 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'failed\|invalid\|refused' || echo 'Security log not available'
description: Security log - monitors failed login attempts and access denials

name: csf-blocked-ips
command: while true; do csf -g 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo 'CSF not available'; sleep 60; done
description: CSF Firewall - monitors blocked IPs and firewall activity
